name: Claude Code Workshop
postCreateCommand: npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code && python3 -m venv --clear .venv && .venv/bin/python -m pip install --upgrade pip && .venv/bin/python -m pip install -r requirements.txt && echo 'for v in /workspaces/*/.venv/bin/activate; do [ -f "$v" ] && . "$v" && break; done' >> ~/.bashrc && cp -n extra/.claude.json ~/ ; grep -qs claude-yolo ~/.bash_aliases || echo 'alias claude-yolo="claude --dangerously-skip-permissions"' >> ~/.bash_aliases
postAttachCommand: cp -n extra/.claude.json ~/ ; grep -qs claude-yolo ~/.bash_aliases || echo 'alias claude-yolo="claude --dangerously-skip-permissions"' >> ~/.bash_aliases
